entrypoint: python3 -m pip install -q 'ray[default]' && ray start --head --node-ip-address='10.0.0.1' --port='6379' --dashboard-host=0.0.0.0 --object-store-memory='4294967296' --temp-dir='/mnt/ray/leanstral-vllm' && until ray status ... (2 active nodes); do sleep 3; done && vllm serve ...

measured.concurrency_notes: 30-token prompts: 4 concurrent 72.7 cumulative gen tok/s (~18.5 per run); 7 concurrent 108.13 cumulative gen / 115.66 e2e tok/s (~15.5 per run).
measured.source_line: tok-s-benchmark.html: 'Best Per-Session Gen 21.08 tok/s Single-session baseline'

extra_setup: Each container pip-installs ray[default] at start (the image lacks the Ray CLI), so both nodes need internet. Head container runs Ray head, waits for 2 active nodes, then vllm serve. Worker (over SSH to 10.0.0.2) runs 'ray start --node-ip-address=10.0.0.2 --address=10.0.0.1:6379 --object-store-memory=4294967296 --temp-dir=/tmp/ray --block' with VLLM_HOST_IP=10.0.0.2, RAY_TMPDIR=/tmp/ray and spill dir /mnt/spark1/ray/leanstral-vllm-spill, no RAY_ADDRESS. Host dirs /mnt/ray/leanstral-vllm and /mnt/ray/leanstral-vllm-spill are bind-mounted at the same paths. HF caches: head /home/zurih/.cache/huggingface, worker WORKER_HF_HOME (default /mnt/spark1/models/.cache/huggingface); weights download on first start from inside each container. Passwordless SSH to the worker.
notes: Native FP8 checkpoint (params.json qformat_weight fp8_e4m3); no quantization flag passed. Optional EAGLE (ENABLE_EAGLE=1): --speculative-config {"model":"mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603-eagle","num_speculative_tokens":3,"method":"eagle","max_model_len":"65536"}. README says it is unstable (execute_model timeout in shm_broadcast, chat crashes), so it is off by default. FLASH_ATTN_MLA is invalid on GB10, so no attention backend is forced. Model card recommends <=200k context; this runs 256k. Thinking should be off by default: reasoning_effort 'none'. README mentions PLANS.md but it is not in the repo. No LICENSE file.
